description: JVIZ Gantt Chart 2.0 features several new enhancements that will position your dashboard ahead of your peers and make your team shine. JVIZ Gantt Chart 2.0 is an effective project management visual that is slide-deck ready, easy to use, and aesthetically pleasing for your audience. Whether you are a project manager, event scheduler, SCRUM master, JVIZ Gantt Chart 2.0 provides a professional view into your portfolio. Key features include: 1. Expand and collapse into your task hierarchy. 2. Visualize task completion by percent range. 3. Select from a library of custom icons for tracking tasks. 4. Visualize milestones to stay on top of key phases. 3. Track dependencies across related tasks. 4. Responsive zoom to drill down into timeline. 5. Manage visibility of project attributes and external links.
